implemented: Vault snapshots hash every regular file and record symlink targets without following them.
Read operations return original bytes and revisions without creating app data or modifying the vault.
Writes compare the current revision, preserve the previous version outside the vault, and replace through a same-directory temporary file.
Stale writes are rejected while preserving incoming bytes in a separate conflict record.
